reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Model matrix, recovery, enzyme/artifact checks and proposed alternative chemistry/mapping.

checks.reason: No complete prospective known-product positive, enzyme/substrate-free negative and matched procedural control design with each role; named generic artifact checks or vehicle alone are insufficient.
No plan to consult prior Methods/supplements or validated protocols and check transfer before execution.
No detector/product reference calibration with acceptance criterion and failed-calibration action.
Units and kinetic parameters are reported, but the proposed rate endpoint lacks baseline correction and weak/saturated/missing-value rules.
Two errors: weak ES inhibitor binding corresponds to standard alpha-prime near 1, not large; apparent Km is not generally an equilibrium binding affinity, so the stated equivalence is unjustified.
